title: Getting ready for floods
summaryZh: 英格兰的新信息入口把风险、预警与房屋防护建议放在一起，屏幕之外还有防洪设施和应急队伍。
levelReason: 编辑估计A2：以网站用途和具体准备工作为主，使用常见现在时与can；少量防洪词汇配中文释义。

sentences.text: On 12 October 2026, the UK government announced a new website for flood advice in England.
sentences.zh: 2026年10月12日，英国政府宣布推出一个提供英格兰洪水应对建议的新网站。

sentences.text: It is called Flood Action Online, and it brings useful information together in one place.
sentences.zh: 它叫Flood Action Online，将实用信息汇集在一个地方。

sentences.text: People can learn about the flood risk near their home and find out how to get warnings.
sentences.zh: 人们可以了解住宅附近的洪水风险，并查找接收预警的方法。

sentences.text: They can also find weather alerts from the Met Office when there is a problem.
sentences.zh: 出现天气状况时，他们也可以找到英国气象局发布的天气警报。

sentences.text: The website helps homeowners find changes they can make to better protect their property from flooding.
sentences.zh: 该网站帮助房主了解可以采取哪些改进措施，让房产更能抵御洪水。

sentences.text: The announcement also describes work away from computer screens.
sentences.zh: 这则公告也介绍了电脑屏幕之外的工作。

sentences.text: The government is spending money to repair old flood defences and build new ones.
sentences.zh: 政府正在投入资金维修旧的防洪设施并建设新的设施。

sentences.text: Its target is for 200,000 properties to benefit from this investment.
sentences.zh: 其目标是让20万处房产受益于这项投资。

sentences.text: The Environment Agency has 260 mobile pumps and 25 kilometres of temporary barriers ready to use.
sentences.zh: 英国环境署备有260台移动水泵和25公里可随时使用的临时屏障。

sentences.text: It responds to flooding emergencies all day and all night, with 600 people on call at any one time.
sentences.zh: 环境署昼夜应对洪水紧急情况，任何一个时刻都有600人待命。

sentences.text: It also offers free flood warnings, so people can prepare before water causes problems.
sentences.zh: 环境署还提供免费的洪水预警，让人们能在洪水造成问题之前做好准备。

words.note: warnings为复数，指可能发生洪水的提前通知。
protect their property表示保护房产；to后用动词原形。
repair old flood defences指修复旧防洪设施，不是拆除或出售。
temporary barriers指临时使用的屏障，与永久建筑不同。
free在此表示不收费，而不是自由的。

phrases.note: 指需要时可以响应，并非正在打电话。

sentences.note: Its target is for…to…表达目标，不把计划受益数量误当已经完成的成果。

questions.text: Where would you look for local weather warnings?
questions.zh: 你会去哪里寻找当地天气预警？

expressions.note: 原创讨论表达，不是报道中的引语。
